text_block_list.text:
I came along to observe
Satono Crown's dance lesson today, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh? If it isn't Chevalier.
Isn't it still your reserved time slot? Heading back already?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Y-Yeah.
...I can't dance it all the way through, so I figured, maybe that's enough.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
If I can't even dance it from start to finish,
getting better isn't even in the question...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wanna practice together with me?
I was just wanting to check our spacing when dancing in a group!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh... N-No, I told you, right?
I can't dan—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
No problem! Distance doesn't require precise swings.
So, if you're up for it, please join me!
choice_data_list: I have a favor to ask too.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... umm...
In that case, just a little bit......

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks! Alright, let's start
with Part A first."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Part by part?
Um... don't you need to see the whole dance?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'm confident!
Just leave it all to me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hao! Keep it up!
You're doing wonderfully!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-It's true...
I didn't stutter even once.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"If you break down the choreography
and memorize it part by part, you can totally do it!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It's difficult because you're trying to learn everything all at once.
Even I would get confused if I tried that.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh, Crown-san too...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Even I'm not perfect, you know.
I grow by building up little things step by step.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It's the same for everyone.
No one can do everything right from the start.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"So don't give up, okay?
Let's do our best together. Deal?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I'll try... as much as I can.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Excellent! At this rate,
you'll definitely be able to dance flawlessly!
choice_data_list: Crown's dancing is getting sharper too!
I'm sure you'll be able to dance it all the way through in no time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
As I thought, having the two of us brings far greater rewards!
Thank you, Cheval! It's all thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh, ah... Mine...!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Naturally! Now, let's keep this momentum going and master the ultimate dance!

Even after that, the two kept up their dance lessons,
mastering movements that were sharper than ever.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder if that's true...
But, I'm just......

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh, didn't you say it yourself?
"I didn't stumble even once."
You must have noticed how much you've improved!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, it'll definitely be fine.
Come on, let's do our best together!

Afterward, the two patiently continued their lesson.
As a result, they were able to pull off
the entire dance brilliantly from start to finish.
